review.representation: Strict straight RGBA8/top-row-first GPU input; opaque F01 decoded BMP valid directly. No implicit lossy unpremultiplication. Exact partial-alpha decoder/cache adapter remains open.
review.rendering: Actual GPU source texture upload, original trace UV order adapted to top-row-first data, nearest/linear clamp-to-edge and explicit source-alpha/one-minus-source-alpha blending for RGB and alpha. No depth attachment, no culling. Four homogeneous clip-space corners supplied explicitly.
review.lifetime: Real prepared native command buffers plus CadFrameGate leases, max3. Replacement owns separate immutable textures. Disposed renderer defers pipeline/queue release until all recorded frames complete or abort. Readback occurs only after real GPU completion; no success delegate substitute.
review.remaining: Original format/cache/alpha conversion, GDI filtering, screen/world/visible image integration, full source setters/document/PC/physical acceptance remain required. This is offscreen GPU component only.
review.edgeTest: Review strengthened the clipped1x1-image case to filtered=true, exercising linear border taps and distinguishing clamp-to-edge from clamp-to-zero. Renderer configuration unchanged; new actual Apple run pending.

runtimeRegression.cause: Observed callback status NotEnqueued; code had a completion handler before actual commit and no released-frame guard. Inferred cleanup/cancellation callback hazard; failed artifact alone does not identify the exact test checkpoint.
runtimeRegression.fix: Install completion handler only at CommitAsync, and ignore callbacks after frame resources have already been released. Genuine submitted/unreleased GPU failures still fault the task; no pixel/resource gates removed.
